tickets.title: Evaluate lapse reinstatement for Paper Otter Life policy
tickets.text: Evaluate lapse and reinstatement options for Soren Cloudpuddle's $750,000 Paper Otter Life term policy after premium draft failure due to Teacup Comet Bank checking account replacement, to preserve existing underwriting terms.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-13 agreed: evaluate lapse/reinstatement after notice showed draft failure when checking was replaced, before losing existing underwriting terms.

tickets.title: Review term coverage and disability protection
tickets.text: Review term life coverage and disability protection for Soren Cloudpuddle given Lila Cloudpuddle's reduced part-time work increasing household reliance on his salary, considering $620,000 mortgage, childcare, and education funding for Rowan Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-20 agreed: review term-coverage/disability-protection after Lila reduced paid-work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary, with mortgage/childcare/education-funding exposure.
